feeds.title: DoggyMom.com
feeds.description: The blog about everything Dog by Kathleen Crisley. Kathleen became the first Fear Free certified massage and rehab practitioner in New Zealand, as an ongoing commitment to her clients to work with their sometimes painful and uncomfortable dogs without causing additional stress.

feeds.title: Proud Dog Mom
feeds.description: Sharing healthy dog treat recipes, health advice, and training tips that inspire modern pet parents to raise happy and healthy fur babies. Proud Dog Mom was founded by Melissa and Donna, a mother/daughter duo who have raised pooches for decades.

feeds.title: Toronto Dog Moms Blog
feeds.description: Blogging about all things for pet parents. City dog owners and the resources to navigating raising a dog in Toronto. Toronto Dog Moms is home to valuable information on pet health, events, and a community where all moms can connect and feel supported.

feeds.title: The Accidental Dog Mom Blog
feeds.description: The Accidental Dog Mom is a versatile individual with a passion for Law, creating delicious dishes in the kitchen, and expressing myself through art and writing Follow her on her journey from a carefree teen to a miserable and anxious dame, a responsible Dog Mom, and finally a respectable adult.

feeds.title: Wear Wag Repeat Blog
feeds.description: Wear Wag Repeat is dedicated to helping women live their best life with dogs - as pet parents and petpreneurs. Discover blog posts about doggy lifestyle, dog toy & food reviews, DIY tutorials and dog-friendly travel guides.

feeds.title: Pet Parents' Place Blog
feeds.description: We founded Pet Parents' Place because we love pets; particularly rescue pets. And we also love pet parents; particularly those of rescue pets. We found many pet parents had to give up their rescues. So we created our company to bring the past and present pet parents, including fosters, together online to bring peace of mind that their beloved pet has found a loving home. Check out our blog to know more about pets we have rescues, tips for fostering furry friends and more!

feeds.title: Keep the Tail Wagging Blog
feeds.description: 'Keep the Tail Wagging' is a dynamic and informative blog dedicated to natural canine care, founded by Kimberly Gauthier. As a certified professional canine nutritionist, Kimberly shares her journey and insights into raw feeding and holistic dog care. Starting from her personal experience transitioning her dogs to a raw diet, the blog has evolved into a resource for pet parents interested in alternative health strategies. Through personal stories, expert advice, and comprehensive guides, Kimberly encourages dog owners to think critically about pet nutrition and wellness​.

feeds.title: on the B.L.
feeds.description: RaeAnna Rekemeyer is a wandering bibliophile, dog mama, foodie, advocate, fashionista, linguist, and more. She writes about her life, her interests, and her thoughts on a variety of topics, including books, lifestyle, and current events. The blog is full of personality and wit, and RaeAnna's writing is sure to entertain and inform readers alike.

feeds.title: Dog Mom Blog
feeds.description: At Dog Mom, the team understands the challenges faced by dog lovers in finding locally available, affordable, and high-quality dog-themed items that truly resonate with their passion. That's why they have embarked on a quest to create a treasure trove of unique, hand-picked products that speak the language of every dog mom's heart.

feeds.title: Leila Grandemange Blog
feeds.description: Leila Grandemange is an award-winning author, wife, mother, and dog mom whose passion is sharing comfort and joy and the loving care of our furry friends! Her genuine approach to communicating, often using storytelling and faith stories for pet lovers, help people easily connect with hope-filled messages relevant to their day-to-day struggles.

feeds.title: LinasDog Blog
feeds.description: LinasDogBlog is a blog written by Lina, a five-year-old Toy Australian Shepherd who lives in Florida. Lina's blog posts are written from her perspective and give readers a glimpse into her life as a dog with a difficult momma. In her posts, Lina shares stories about her adventures, her thoughts on human behavior, and her love of all things furry.

feeds.title: Las Motherpuppers Blog
feeds.description: Las Motherpuppers of Puerto Rico is a lifestyle blog and club created by three dog moms who joined together & inspired by their love for their dogs. The aim is to create a community with like-minded dog moms & their dogs to connect and inspire each other through educational content, collaborations, bonding activities & sharing products we love.

feeds.title: Dog Mom in the Wild Blog
feeds.description: This blog helps you and your herding dog live and thrive both in the city and in the wild! Jolene Seville is 30-something adventuring dog mom living the van life with her dog Sheila. Exploring, hiking, and traveling the USA.

feeds.title: DC Dog Moms Blog
feeds.description: Bringing together pups & people in our fave DC places. DC Dog Moms is run by friends Charlotte and Heather who met--not coincidentally--through their dogs.

feeds.title: Houston Dog Mom
feeds.description: Feeling overwhelmed navigating Houston's dog scene? Tail wags and happy barks await at Houston Dog Mom! This one-stop shop caters to everything the discerning Houston Dog Mom needs to keep her furry friend flourishing. Whether you're seeking the perfect dog walker, scouting out reputable rescues, or whipping up delicious homemade treats, Houston Dog Mom serves as your ultimate resource guide.

feeds.title: The Pet Divas Blog
feeds.description: Explore tips, stories, and fun from our professional dog moms! Read all the latest in dog mom trends on our blog. The pet Divas provide superior quality service and love for your pets and the utmost convenience in care. We send live updates during every visit with your pet, including photos with GPS tracking.

feeds.title: The DINK Dog Mom Blog
feeds.description: I'm Blair. The DINK Dog Mom is a lifestyle blog for badass women who live adventurously and love their dogs like their kids. This blog is my way of sharing everything I learned as a struggling dog mom in my 20s, and all of my adventures as a slightly-more-experienced dog mom in my 30s.

feeds.title: Dog Mom Tribe Blog
feeds.description: Our mission at Dog Mom Tribe is to help dog moms like you live your best life with your pup. We provide helpful content to thrive as a dog mom: from product reviews, favorites list, lifestyle tips, dog treat/food recipes, gift guides & more. We also help dog-momagers, pet brands & petfluencers build your brand online.

feeds.title: Pinoy Dog Mom
feeds.description: Pinoy Dog Mom is a blog managed and owned by myself, Ton Reyes, a writer who has lived her entire life with dogs. In creating this blog, she aims to share knowledge and insights from her years as a dog owner, especially of miniature schnauzers.

feeds.title: Hudson Valley Dog Mom
feeds.description: Hudson Valley Dog Mom by Stephanie, is a place to learn and read about bits and bobs about Stephanie's life and her dogs.

feeds.title: Pawsitive Dog Mom
feeds.description: Pawsitive Dog Mom is a blog and website by Keely, a dog mom of 12, cat mom, career design coach, pet nutrition specialist, pet health and wellness consultant, and creative. The website offers a variety of resources for dog moms, including articles on pet health and wellness, dog mom life, and personal development. Keely also offers a free monthly pet planner and a variety of pet health and wellness products.

feeds.title: Happy-Go-Doodle Blog
feeds.description: Happy-Go-Doodle® is the friendliest online publication for Doodle dog enthusiasts. Inspired by one happy-go-lucky family dog named Chloe, the mission is to celebrate and nurture the bond between Goldendoodles (and Doodly mixes) and the pet parents who love them.

feeds.title: Kolchak, the DIY dog
feeds.description: Kol's Notes is a delightful and informative blog run by Jodi Chick, a dedicated dog mom who blends her passion for DIY projects, dog care, and humor into engaging content. This blog not only offers practical advice on crafting homemade dog treats and natural cleaning tips but also shares personal anecdotes and lessons learned from Jodi's life with her dogs, particularly her beloved puggle, Kolchak. Jodi's experiences and creative ideas aim to help fellow dog owners create a fun, loving, and healthy environment for their pets.

feeds.title: Sniffs & Pawsitivity Blog
feeds.description: Chenee is encouraging women and pet parents to walk & make time for themselves and their pets because restoring the body through mindful movement can be one of the most PAWSitive things you can do for yourself & your doggo!

feeds.title: Tara Sutherland Blog
feeds.description: The website is the portfolio of Tara Sutherland, a pet photographer based in New Zealand. The website features a gallery of Tara's work. Tara's photography has a distinct style, with lashings of color, loads of definition, and very cool lighting. She specializes in pet photography, and her work often incorporates New Zealand's gorgeous scenery.

feeds.title: The Fierce Mama Blog
feeds.description: Chelsea is a mom of 5, 3 humans and 2 Pointers. Her goal is to raise them to be FIERCE, in the non-traditional sense. (FIERCE: Have a strong spirit, use bold words, & pursue positive actions.) she is just figuring out this parenting thing, one day at a time, & sharing it with you all!

feeds.title: Dog Mamma's Blog
feeds.description: Dog Mamma's mission is to help you improve your dog's wellness by baking a better treat for your dog. Read tips for keeping your dog fit, exercise, wellness, conditioning & nutrition. Great for dogs that compete in canine sports or family pet and senior pet fitness.

feeds.title: Not So Mommy
feeds.description: Meet Brandi Lytle - a wife, dog mom, aunt, host mom, infertile woman. Here, she shares her infertility journey and how she redefined what it means to be a mom for herself. Join the journey to discover the sunshine after infertility, embrace a fulfilling childless life, and explore the many ways to nurture your motherhood spirit!

feeds.title: Dog Mom Lifestyles Blog
feeds.description: Join Jocelyn on this unique journey empowering women, connecting dog moms, and enjoying the simple pleasures in life with your pups. Jocelyn is the Founder of Dog Mom Lifestyles and BooDog Lifestyles. She is someone who is obsessed with dogs and the amazing way they make you feel.

feeds.title: Hello Ruby Doodle Blog
feeds.description: Melanie, known as Doodle Mom on HelloRubyDoodle, works in the tech industry as a digital marketing manager. As a passionate dog mom, she started HelloRubyDoodle as a creative outlet to merge all her favorite things - travel, photography and her dog - and inspire people to do more with their fur babies.

feeds.title: The Pet Blog Lady
feeds.description: Celebrating the amazing bond people have with their pets and animals in general. Promoting pet-loving entrepreneurs who have created quality products and services for pet parents. Fun and light blog with a dash of humor and touch of silliness.

feeds.title: The Dog Mom Diva Club Blog
feeds.description: Joy is the owner of the Club - a mid-westerner with southern roots, a girl who has found herself to be a dog mom with a clan of Mini/Toy Aussies as her fur babies. She decided to start a blog about her little clan and their adventures. Smiles from watching these cuties living their best life in this quiet little piece of heaven where they live.

feeds.title: Color for Breakfast Blog
feeds.description: Maria is a photographer, party-thrower, and artist, who turned her passion for dogs into her business, Color for Breakfast. Maria translates her love for dogs into colorful, joyous, and eye-catching art. As a dog mom, she understands the importance of really capturing a dog's personality, and bringing it to life. Through vibrant photography and custom-painted illustrations, she creates visual memorabilia for brands to connect with their customers pawsitivily and for fellow pawrents to cherish furever.
